Isolated sperm production and flagellar defects cause male infertility; reproductive function has no axis, with no endocrine dysfunction established.
Familial reflux directly affects the bladder-ureter urinary system; unspecified skeletal findings do not establish common skeletal damage.
Abnormal glycosaminoglycan metabolism, cellular immunodeficiency and nephrotic syndrome define the disorder; frequencies of corneal, hepatic and skeletal damage are unspecified.
Developmental disability and limb defects define syndrome; cardiac malformations and pulmonary hypoplasia each 30-79%; hearing and ocular abnormalities omitted by cap.
The named syndrome combines craniosynostosis/exostoses, a cutaneous nevus and an epibulbar dermoid; no additional organ involvement established.

Neonatal diabetes and epiphyseal dysplasia define disease; liver abnormalities 80-99%, hepatic failure and neutropenia 30-79%; renal and neurologic findings below 30%.
Substance dependence is a psychiatric condition without an axis; cardiovascular or neurologic complications are separate diseases and risks.

Intellectual disability defines disease; amblyopia and bicuspid aortic valve each reported in 1/2; isolated clinodactyly does not establish functional skeletal damage.
Congenital myopathy causes skeletal muscle weakness and structural degeneration; global developmental delay is reported in 80-99%.
Disease of the adrenal cortex, an endocrine gland; no extra-adrenal organ damage applies across the umbrella.
Benign vascular tumour or malformation arises from aberrant venous connections; no consistent extra-vascular site is specified.
Inherited ventricular arrhythmia directly affects cardiac electrical function; syncope and vertigo do not establish neurologic or ear damage.
Neurodegeneration, microphthalmia/cataracts and skeletal contractures define syndrome; sensorineural hearing loss in 1/3; recurrent pneumonia is a separate infection.
Definition specifies a benign neoplasm arising in breast tissue, which has no axis; skin-related ancestors do not override its stated origin.
